01

Why we built it

How do you present a property that does not yet exist, or help someone imagine a different use of an existing home?

02

What we made

Between May and September 2026, three projects for a RE/MAX agent produced six videos. The work explored possible buildings and renovations, along with scenes of people playing, swimming, sharing dinner, and enjoying a home through different seasons.

The videos were designed to make the possibilities and atmosphere of each property easier to imagine.

03

Next steps

Explore further creative briefs and ways to combine property information with an engaging visual story.

Project note

AI concept visualisations show imagined possibilities. They do not document an existing building or guarantee a future renovation.
